offering_description.value: Owns and leases a fleet of railcars to shippers and railroads, and manufactures new railcars and components for lease fleet and third-party customers. Also provides railcar maintenance and management services to railcar owners.

primary_products.value: tank railcars; freight railcars (hopper, boxcars, gondolas); railcar components; specialty railcars

primary_services.value: railcar leasing; railcar fleet management; railcar maintenance and repair

customer_segment.value: B2B: railroads, shippers, chemical, energy and agricultural companies, leasing and financial investors

end_markets.value: railroads; chemicals; energy and petroleum; agriculture; industrial and construction materials

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: lease fees on railcars owned in the lease fleet; product sales: new railcars and components sold to customers and investors; service fees: fleet management and maintenance fees
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and leases railcar fleet to shippers and railroads; OEM / manufacturer: builds railcars from purchased steel and components, sold to lessors, railroads and shippers; service provider: manages and maintains railcars for owners
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; OEM / manufacturer; service provider

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Mexico and Canada, with manufacturing in the US and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: railcar leasing, fleet management and railcar manufacturing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales and lease teams selling to railroads, shippers and lessors

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: railcar safety and tank car standards from FRA, DOT/PHMSA and Association of American Railroads, environmental rules
